name: sparkling-white-saree-portrait
image_vibe: Elegant sparkling white couture with cinematic editorial polish and warm neutral refinement
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion ethnic portrait for lookbook and campaign presentation.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-detailed cinematic editorial studio portrait of an original adult woman wearing a sparkling white saree.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult South Asian woman with natural realistic skin texture, an elegant low or mid bun with a few loose strands, a confident glamorous expression, and a direct soft intense gaze. She wears a structured sparkling white micro-sequin saree with a tailored modern blouse, polished statement earrings, and restrained glamorous makeup.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing portrait with shoulders slightly back and one hand delicately adjusting an earring, elongated elegant neck, refined saree drape, controlled full or medium framing, and a smooth warm neutral beige studio backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft three-point studio lighting with a large front-left softbox, balanced fill, subtle rim light for hair separation, smooth shadows, even natural skin tone, and controlled highlights across the sequins.
prompt.technical_specs: Cinematic editorial studio photography, ultra-detailed photorealism, realistic skin and fabric texture, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, shallow background separation, accurate sequin reflections, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-detailed cinematic editorial studio portrait of an original adult South Asian woman wearing a sparkling white micro-sequin saree with an elegant structured drape and a modern tailored blouse. Give her natural realistic skin texture, an elegant low or mid bun with a few loose strands, polished statement earrings, restrained glamorous makeup, a confident soft intense gaze, and one hand delicately adjusting an earring. Keep the shoulders slightly back and the neck elongated. Use a smooth warm neutral beige backdrop and soft three-point lighting: large front-left softbox, balanced fill, and subtle rim light for hair separation. Render controlled highlights on the sequins, realistic fabric and skin detail, high-resolution 8K-style editorial clarity, and no text or watermark. Use an original face and do not imitate an identifiable person.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identifiable public-figure likeness, distorted hands, extra fingers, broken jewelry, plastic skin, blown highlights, messy saree geometry, text, watermark

assets.name: source sparkling white saree portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for saree construction, pose, jewelry, beige backdrop, and studio lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult South Asian fashion concept, white sparkling saree, elegant bun, earring-adjustment pose, warm beige studio, and controlled editorial lighting. Identity may vary.
